scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @copyrade/signal && npm run build --workspace @copyrade/mobile && npm run build --workspace @copyrade/desktop
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace @copyrade/protocol && npm run build --workspace @copyrade/connection && npm run build --workspace @copyrade/transfer
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.dev:connection: npm run build:shared && concurrently --kill-others --names signal,mobile,desktop "npm run dev --workspace @copyrade/signal" "npm run dev --workspace @copyrade/mobile" "npm start --workspace @copyrade/desktop"
